note: 剧情类 NPC,提及“陨落之星教团”(Cult of the Fallen Star)存在但自称并非成员。

messages.raw: §fHave you heard of the §5Cult of the Fallen Star§f?
messages.text: Have you heard of the Cult of the Fallen Star?

messages.raw: §fI've never seen any members myself but I heard they were growing in numbers.
messages.text: I've never seen any members myself but I heard they were growing in numbers.
messages.zh: 我自己从没见过什么成员,但听说他们的人数正在增长。

messages.raw: §fNot sure what the point of their cult is, but it worries me a bit.
messages.text: Not sure what the point of their cult is, but it worries me a bit.
messages.zh: 我不太清楚他们这个教团到底图什么,但这让我有点担心。

messages.raw: §fThey sometimes show up near the §5Fallen Star §fat night, as far as I know.
messages.text: They sometimes show up near the Fallen Star at night, as far as I know.

segments.text: They sometimes show up near the
segments.zh: 据我所知,他们有时会在夜里出现在

segments.text: at night, as far as I know.

messages.context: 花园访客状态(见 GLOSSARY.md 'Garden Visitor' 词条),提及见到戴面具的可疑人物
messages.text: I saw some weird guy in a mask go into a tiny hole inside the Dwarven Mines, maybe he's part of the Cult of the Fallen Star?
messages.zh: 我看见一个戴面具的怪人钻进了矮人矿山里的一个小洞,他会不会是“陨落之星教团”的人?
messages.raw: §fI saw some weird guy in a mask go into a tiny hole inside the Dwarven Mines, maybe he's part of the Cult of the Fallen Star?

messages.context: 后续互动,表达对教团的担忧
messages.text: These guys... are scaring me. I'm not quite sure what they are planning in there, but I'd also rather not want to know.
messages.zh: 这些家伙……真让我害怕。我不太清楚他们在里面策划什么,但我其实也不想知道。
messages.raw: §fThese guys... are scaring me. I'm not quite sure what they are planning in there, but I'd also rather not want to know.
